info.name: Hospital Service
info.description:
REST API for the Uyir hospital service. Every path is under the /api/v1/hospital prefix. Base URL defaults to http://localhost:8081 (server.port). Pick the "Hospital Service - EC2" environment to hit the deployed server.

Run "Create Hospital" (as HOSPITAL user {{hospitalUserId}}) and "Create Doctor" first — their tests auto-populate the {{hospitalId}} / {{doctorId}} collection variables used by the rest of the requests. Each HOSPITAL user owns at most one hospital, so a second run returns 409 unless {{hospitalUserId}} and the registrationNumber change. Then seat the doctor (Doctor Seats › Get Seats → Assign Doctor to Seat): only seated doctors can be booked, show up in a hospital-filtered doctor search, or count for emergency-sos.

Booking endpoints (Emergency Bookings, Doctor Appointment Bookings) require X-User-Id / X-User-Role headers. In this deployment those are set by the gateway after AuthService validates the caller's token — this service trusts them as-is, it doesn't verify a JWT itself. Requests acting as the patient send X-User-Role: PATIENT with X-User-Id: {{patientId}}; requests acting as the hospital portal send X-User-Role: HOSPITAL with X-User-Id: {{hospitalUserId}} (the AuthService user that created the hospital; the service looks the hospital up by that userId) (a hospital only ever sees/reschedules/closes out its own bookings, scoped by that header, not a query param).

Hospital Analytics endpoints are called by the Admin service with X-User-Role: ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN (the Admin service decides which district an admin manages). Every analytics endpoint is POST with a required "district" body field. "Get All District Metrics" (Hospital Metrics folder) is a GET with the district in the URL (GET /api/v1/hospital/metrics/{{district}}, always the last 30 days) returning summary + per-hospital + trends in one call. A HOSPITAL caller can see only its own figures: "Get My Hospital Metrics" (POST /api/v1/hospital/metrics/my-hospital) and "Get My Hospital Analytics" (POST /api/v1/hospital/analytics/my-hospital), with X-User-Role: HOSPITAL and X-User-Id: {{hospitalUserId}}; the district endpoints stay admin-only. Run "Create Analytics Snapshot" before the snapshot detail/delete requests — it populates {{analyticsSnapshotId}}.

Doctor Seats: GET/PUT/DELETE seats and seat purchases act as HOSPITAL. Buying seats also sends Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}, forwarded to payment-service; for a real (Razorpay test mode) purchase {{accessToken}} must be an AuthService HOSPITAL token whose sub equals {{hospitalUserId}}. "Payment Webhook - Simulate PAID (signed)" signs its body with {{seatWebhookSecret}} (= the server's PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET) to complete a purchase without paying.

Payout Account: PUT/GET /api/v1/hospital/payout-account act as HOSPITAL and register the bank account appointment payments are paid out to (Razorpay Route via payment-service); Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}} is forwarded the same way as for seat purchases.

item.name: Reference Data (Dropdowns)
item.description: Public lists the forms are built from - no login or headers needed. Specialties (131, appointment booking & doctor search) and the 16 emergency conditions (emergency booking only) are separate lists. Send the code; the server stores the official name. See docs/UI-Form.md.

exec: pm.test('entries have code and name', () => pm.expect(body[0].specialties[0]).to.eql({ code: 'GEN001', name: 'General Physician' }));

request.description: Doctor `specialties` and hospital `facilities.specialtyDepartments` must come from this list (appointment booking & doctor search). Grouped by category. Send codes, e.g. ["CAR001"]; stored and returned as names. Unknown value -> 400.

exec: pm.expect(body[0]).to.eql({ code: 'EMG001', name: 'Chest Pain / Sweating / Palpitation', icon: '❤️' });

request.description: The patient's SOS choices (code goes in emergencyType). The hospital's emergencyServices.specialtyEmergencyConditionsHandled and each doctor's emergencyConditionsHandled use the same list. Emergency booking only - not linked to specialties.

pm.test('201 Created (409 = hospitalUserId already owns a hospital / registrationNumber taken)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));

request.description: HOSPITAL-only: the caller's X-User-Id ({{hospitalUserId}}, the AuthService user id) is stored as the hospital's userId, and every later HOSPITAL request resolves its hospital from that header. One hospital per user, and registrationNumber is unique — re-running returns 409, so change {{hospitalUserId}} and registrationNumber to create another. Also creates the hospital's FREE doctor seat. Captures {{hospitalId}}.

request.description: All hospitals whose address.district matches (case-insensitive), full records sorted by name. Optional ?active=true|false; omit for both.
The logged-in hospital's own profile, resolved from X-User-Id (Hospital.userId). Requires X-User-Role: HOSPITAL (403 otherwise); 404 if this user hasn't created a hospital yet.

PUT replaces the whole record: send every section (facilities, emergencyServices, staffDetails, operations, …), or the ones left out are cleared — e.g. dropping emergencyServices makes the hospital reject every emergency booking.

Turns the hospital's emergencyServices.handlesEmergencies flag on/off. Set "handlesEmergencies": false to immediately exclude this hospital from Emergency SOS results and reject new emergency bookings against it.

Body filters (all optional): specialty, hospitalId, engagementType, doctorCategory, active. With hospitalId set, only doctors holding one of that hospital's seats are returned (Doctor Seats › Assign Doctor to Seat).

item.name: Doctor Seats
item.description:
Every hospital gets 1 FREE seat; each extra seat is a one-time purchase (hospital.seat.price-per-seat, ₹10,000) paid through payment-service (Razorpay). Only a doctor sitting in a seat is bookable for appointments and listed by emergency-sos.

All requests act as the hospital (X-User-Role: HOSPITAL, X-User-Id: {{hospitalUserId}}). The purchase requests also need Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}: hospitalservice forwards it to payment-service, which checks the token's sub equals the payer, so with SEAT_PAYMENT_PROVIDER=http {{hospitalUserId}} must be the sub of an AuthService HOSPITAL token. With SEAT_PAYMENT_PROVIDER=mock any token works and purchases are PAID at once.

Order: Get Seats (captures {{seatId}}) → Assign Doctor to Seat → Remove → Re-assign (leaves the doctor seated for the booking folders) → Buy Seats (captures {{seatPurchaseId}}, {{seatPaymentId}}, {{seatPurchaseAmount}}; the checkout URL is printed to the Postman console) → pay → Get Seats again.

exec: pm.test('has at least the free seat', () => pm.expect(body.totalSeats).to.be.at.least(1));
const seat = body.seats.find(s => !s.doctorId) || body.seats.find(s => s.seatType === 'FREE') || body.seats[0];

request.description: Lists the hospital's seats (free + paid), who sits in each, the total/occupied/empty counts and the price per seat. Creates the free seat on the first call. Captures an empty seat (or the free one) as {{seatId}}.

Puts {{doctorId}} in seat {{seatId}}, or swaps out the doctor sitting there. The doctor must be active and associated with this hospital. 409 if the outgoing doctor has upcoming CONFIRMED/RESCHEDULED appointments here.
Empties seat {{seatId}}. Same rule as a swap: 409 while the doctor has upcoming appointments at this hospital.
Puts {{doctorId}} back in {{seatId}} after the removal above, so the doctor is bookable in the Doctor Appointment Bookings folder and counted by emergency-sos.

exec: if (body.checkoutUrl) console.log('Open to pay (Razorpay test mode):', body.checkoutUrl);

request.description: Starts a purchase of 1-50 seats. Returns 201 with status PENDING and a checkoutUrl (Razorpay payment link, valid 20 minutes); the seats are created when payment-service reports PAID. 503 if payment-service is unreachable.

exec: if (body.checkoutUrl) console.log('Open to pay (Razorpay test mode):', body.checkoutUrl);

request.description: New checkout link for an unpaid (PENDING or FAILED) purchase, e.g. after the 20-minute link expired.
The hospital's purchase history, newest first.
Validation: quantity must be 1-50.
Seat endpoints are HOSPITAL-only.

item.name: Get Seats for User Without Hospital (expect 403)

request.description: A HOSPITAL caller that hasn't created a hospital yet gets 403 ("No hospital is registered for user …") on every hospital-scoped endpoint.

exec: // Signs the body the way payment-service does: hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp + '.' + rawBody)).
if (!secret) throw new Error('Set seatWebhookSecret in the environment (= PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET)');

request.description: Called by payment-service only, never by apps. No user token: authenticated by X-Payment-Timestamp / X-Payment-Signature (HMAC-SHA256, 5-minute window), which the pre-request script computes from {{seatWebhookSecret}}. Use it to finish a purchase locally without paying (run Buy Seats first). Idempotent: sending it twice creates the seats once. 401 on a bad/expired signature, 503 if PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET is not set on the server.

item.name: Payout Account
item.description:
The bank account patients' appointment payments are paid out to (Razorpay Route). Hospital-only: every request acts as the hospital (X-User-Role: HOSPITAL, X-User-Id: {{hospitalUserId}}) and resolves its hospital from that user, so run Hospitals › Create Hospital first.

hospitalservice forwards Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}} to payment-service (PUT /api/payments/linked-accounts, POST /api/payments/linked-accounts/{id}/refresh). With the http payout client {{accessToken}} must be an AuthService HOSPITAL token whose sub equals {{hospitalUserId}}; with the mock client any token works.

Status goes PENDING_DETAILS → UNDER_REVIEW → ACTIVATED (or NEEDS_CLARIFICATION, with `requirements` listing what to fix - PUT the full details again). Payouts are enabled only once ACTIVATED. Only the last 4 digits of the account number are ever returned.

Order: Set Up Payout Account → Get Payout Account.

request.description:
Sets up, continues (after NEEDS_CLARIFICATION or a failed attempt) or changes the hospital's payout bank account. Send the full details every time: steps already done at Razorpay are skipped, and once the Razorpay account exists only bankAccount can still change.

- `businessType`: individual, proprietorship, partnership, private_limited, public_limited, llp, ngo, trust, society, not_yet_registered, educational_institutes.
- `pan` is the business PAN, `stakeholder.pan` the signatory's personal PAN; `gst` is optional.
- `tncAccepted` must be true (Razorpay Route terms).

**200** the account and its status, **400** validation error, **403** caller is not a HOSPITAL with a hospital, **404** hospital not found, **503** payment-service unreachable.

The hospital's payout account. Until it is ACTIVATED the status is refreshed from payment-service (Razorpay) on every call; if payment-service is down the last known status is returned. **404** before Set Up Payout Account has run.

item.name: Emergency Bookings
item.description:
Patient requests, hospital responds. Lifecycle: REQUESTED → accept → ACCEPTED → complete → COMPLETED; REQUESTED → reject (reason) → REJECTED; REQUESTED / ACCEPTED → cancel (patient, reason) → CANCELLED. REJECTED, CANCELLED and COMPLETED are final (further changes → 409). accept / reject / complete are HOSPITAL-only ({{hospitalUserId}}, scoped to the hospital that user created); cancel is PATIENT-only and only for the patient’s own booking.

The hospital must handle the emergencyType (emergencyServices.specialtyEmergencyConditionsHandled) or Create returns 400. Each path below creates its own booking and overwrites {{emergencyBookingId}}.

request.description: Hospital takes the emergency on: REQUESTED -> ACCEPTED (sets acceptedAt). Only the hospital the booking was made to (resolved from X-User-Id). 409 if the booking is no longer REQUESTED.
Hospital closes out an accepted emergency: ACCEPTED -> COMPLETED (sets completedAt). 409 unless the booking is ACCEPTED. Run Accept first.
A fresh REQUESTED booking for the reject path (the first one is COMPLETED by now). Overwrites {{emergencyBookingId}}.

exec: pm.test('reason recorded', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().rejectionReason).to.eql('No ICU bed available right now'));

request.description: Hospital turns the emergency down with a reason: REQUESTED -> REJECTED (sets rejectedAt, rejectionReason). reason is required (max 500). 409 unless the booking is REQUESTED - run Create Emergency Booking again first if you already accepted it.
A fresh REQUESTED booking for the cancel path. Overwrites {{emergencyBookingId}}.

exec: pm.test('reason recorded', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().cancellationReason).to.eql('Went to a closer hospital'));

request.description: Patient withdraws their own request with a reason: REQUESTED or ACCEPTED -> CANCELLED (sets cancelledAt, cancellationReason). reason is required (max 500). 409 once the booking is REJECTED, CANCELLED or COMPLETED.
CANCELLED, REJECTED and COMPLETED are final - any further transition is a 409.
reason is required (max 500 chars) for reject and cancel.
accept / reject / complete are HOSPITAL-only; cancel is PATIENT-only.

exec: pm.test('every booking is the patient\'s', () => pm.response.json().forEach(b => pm.expect(b.patientId).to.eql(pm.variables.get('patientId'))));

item.name: Doctor Appointment Bookings
item.description:
Patient books, hospital manages. X-User-Id / X-User-Role come from the gateway in production.

Order: Create (captures {{appointmentBookingId}}) → lists → Reschedule (hospital) → Update Status (hospital; only after the scheduled time) → Cancel (patient or hospital).

Prerequisite: the doctor must hold a seat at the hospital — run Doctor Seats › Get Seats and Assign Doctor to Seat first, otherwise Create returns 400.

request.description:
Books an appointment as the patient. Required: hospitalId, doctorId, appointmentDateTime (future), patientName, patientPhone, patientAge (0-130), patientGender (MALE | FEMALE | OTHER). Optional: durationMinutes (5-120), consultationType (IN_PERSON default | TELECONSULT), visitType (NEW default | FOLLOW_UP + previousAppointmentId), reason, symptoms (≤20), bookedFor (SELF default | FAMILY_MEMBER + relationship).

The doctor must be active, associated with the hospital and sitting in one of its seats (Doctor Seats › Assign Doctor to Seat), and the slot must be free. The response carries tokenNumber — the doctor's queue number for that day. Captures {{appointmentBookingId}}.

item.name: Create Appointment Booking for Family Member (Patient)

request.description: The logged-in patient books on behalf of a family member. bookedFor: FAMILY_MEMBER requires relationship (SPOUSE | PARENT | CHILD | SIBLING | GRANDPARENT | GRANDCHILD | OTHER); the patient* fields describe the family member.

exec: // 400 until the appointment's scheduled time has passed.
pm.test('200 OK or 400 before scheduled time', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 400]));

request.description: Hospital-only: closes out a CONFIRMED / RESCHEDULED appointment as COMPLETED or NO_SHOW. Rejected with 400 before the appointment's scheduled time, so against the sample future booking this returns 400.

Patient or hospital can cancel its own CONFIRMED / RESCHEDULED appointment; reason is required (≤500 chars). To cancel as the hospital, send X-User-Role: HOSPITAL with X-User-Id: {{hospitalUserId}} (the AuthService user that created the hospital; the service looks the hospital up by that userId). Run last — a cancelled booking can't be rescheduled or closed out.

request.description: The family-member booking above is still CONFIRMED and in the future, so freeing the doctor's seat is refused until it is cancelled or completed.

item.name: Hospital Metrics
item.description: Business metrics in one JSON object, service-wide or for one district. Service-wide: POST with optional { fromDate, toDate } body (empty body allowed). District: { district, fromDate?, toDate? }, district required. Headers: X-User-Role ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN, X-User-Id. GET /api/v1/hospital/metrics/{district}: district in the URL, no body or dates (always the last 30 days); returns the full district report (summary + per-hospital + daily trends).

request.description: Hospital/doctor counts are current; booking total/byStatus use fromDate/toDate (yyyy-MM-dd, IST, inclusive; default last 30 days).
Same metrics scoped to one district (address.district, case-insensitive). district is required; fromDate/toDate optional.

HOSPITAL only. The same counts as the district metrics, for the caller's own hospital - resolved from X-User-Id (the AuthService user that created it). Body optional; omit for the last 30 days. Returns 403 if the user has no hospital.

item.name: Hospital Analytics
item.description:
District-level analytics. Called by the Admin service on behalf of an admin - this service doesn't look admins up.

- Every endpoint is POST with a JSON body. For everything in one GET, see "Get All District Metrics" in Hospital Metrics.
- Headers: X-User-Role ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN, X-User-Id = the admin's id.
- district is required in every body. The Admin service decides which district an admin may see; this service trusts it.
- Hospitals belong to a district via address.district (case-insensitive).

request.description: HOSPITAL only. The caller's own hospital figures (beds, doctors, bookings by status) plus daily trends. Hospital resolved from X-User-Id; no district in the body. Body optional; omit for the last 30 days.

item.name: Service Health & Docs
item.description: Spring Boot actuator, at /api/v1/hospital/actuator, plus the springdoc OpenAPI spec. Health is used by the k8s probes and the ALB health check. No X-User headers needed.

request.description: Overall health (includes the MongoDB check). Liveness/readiness are at /api/v1/hospital/actuator/health/liveness and /readiness.
springdoc-generated OpenAPI JSON. Swagger UI is at /api/v1/hospital/swagger-ui.html (open it in a browser).
